This notice of rulemaking is issued under the authority of sections 552, 553, and 559 of the Administrative Procedure Act (5 U.S.C. 552, 553, and 559) and sections 202, 203, 204, 207, 209, 402, 403, and 404 of the Interstate Commerce Act (49 U.S.C. 302, 303, 304, 307, 309, 1002, 1003, and 1004). By the Commission.
(SEAL)
ROBERT L. OSWALD, Secretary.
Accordingly, 49 CFR 1041, 1048, and 1049 are hereby modified in the following manner:
(1) Delete sections 1041.21 and 1041.22.
(2) The following section replaces those deleted:
1041.21 Operating authority to serve particular unincorporated community, construction.
